filename: TRANSFER NEYMAN-PEARSON ALGORITHM FOR OUTLIER DETECTION.pdf
title: Transfer Neyman-Pearson Algorithm for Outlier Detection
testbed_rationale: The paper develops a generic theoretical transfer learning classification / outlier detection algorithm and tests it on subsets of ClimSim, NASA POWER, and non-climate datasets. It does not introduce a parameterization benchmark or testbed.
pain_points: Extreme class imbalance in rare event detection (heavy precipitation)
Scarcity of target abnormal/extreme event samples
Negative transfer when source domain distribution diverges significantly from target domain
Computational intractability of non-convex/0-1 indicator loss in constrained Neyman-Pearson classification
extraction_notes: The paper focuses on ML theory and transfer learning methodology for outlier detection under the Neyman-Pearson paradigm, evaluated on climate precipitation data (ClimSim and NASA POWER) as motivating applications.
